costumeStyle: 女性化白／深紫黑／细金边、裙装、白色腿部服装和紫色鞋靴，贴近角色参考图。

shots.action: 固定海岸宽景连续14秒，保留原海浪、道路与房屋；右下蓝蝶保持同一位置和清晰身体结构，两侧翅膀围绕身体根部自然对称开合，每约4秒完成一次舒缓周期，短暂停歇；不翻转、不扭曲、不拖出重影。片尾文字仍由后期叠加。
shots.prompt: One uninterrupted fifteen-second very wide coastal landscape shot from Picture 1, filmed in extreme slow motion with an absolutely fixed camera. Match the original unobstructed view from the open beach: the upper and left portions are clear open sky and sea exactly as in Picture 1. There is NO foreground tree, NO overhanging branch and NO foreground leaf anywhere in this frame. The original sea, distant horizon, pebble beach, road, poles, houses and sky remain visible at the same scale for the entire take. Gentle small waves breathe along the shore. The original small blue wing ornament at the bottom right is nearly at rest: across the ENTIRE FIFTEEN SECONDS it makes only ONE very gradual opening followed by ONE very gradual closing, a single calm breathing gesture, with long pauses. Both wings bend only at their shared central root. Keep its blue markings, original small size and corner location. Its motion is almost imperceptibly slow, never a rapidly beating flying insect. Keep the complete coast in view while it moves, with no camera approach, focus pull, pan, zoom, transition, cut or alternative scene. No added vegetation, object, person, human body, reflection, lettering, narration, voice, singing or humming. Leave the sky open for later titles.
